fixed_Full_revision_proposals.rationale: Revise the installed airline helper without changing its supported route schedules or reader contract. The change makes the 70-pound allowance depend directly on the first two complimentary checked-bag ordinals for Business or First passengers, preventing a complimentary East Asia bag from being assessed under the 50-pound charged-bag limit while preserving the already-correct South America history case.
